# Initial Mourning

> Funeral Rites (Xiongli, the Rites of Mourning) / Initial Mourning · 10 entries

The rites of the earliest phase: dying, summoning the soul, washing the body, filling the mouth, announcing the death, appointing the chief mourner and receiving condolences.

> English bodies available: **10 / 10**. Entries marked `Chinese` link to the Chinese original.
